notes.subject: ofa bilong paia long wanwan ples
notes.rationale: מוקטר מוגש read as present ('is offered') or future ('will be offered') — famous crux over who offers it among the nations.

notes.subject: גדול שמי בגוים
notes.rationale: Inclusio: clause repeated verbatim before and after the oracle formula — Hebrew frame structure kept.

notes.subject: long hap we san i kirap i go insait
notes.rationale: Verse spans whole earth east-to-west as a measured extent of the Name's greatness.

translation: Bikos long hap we san i kirap, i go daun na i go insait, nem bilong mi i bikpela long ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri; na long wanwan ples, ol i presentim ofa bilong paia long nem bilong mi, wantaim minkha klin, bikos nem bilong mi i bikpela long ol lain bilong ol narapela kantri, Yahwe Tsebaot i tok.
